context.//: WEAK cross-stack references, and this one is not a tidy-up -- without it the read gate's code cannot be changed at all. SiteStack takes the Lambda@Edge VERSION arn from SigenAuthEdge, and CDK turns that into a CloudFormation Export whose NAME embeds the version's logical id, which embeds the code's asset hash. So editing one line of auth-edge/index.js renames the export, and CloudFormation refuses: 'Cannot delete export ... as it is in use by SigenSite'. A CFN export's value cannot be changed while another stack imports it, and the old value's resource is gone, so there is nothing to keep alive. Weak references replace Fn::ImportValue with Fn::GetStackOutput, which the CDK CLI resolves at deploy time and inlines as a literal -- no export, so the deadlock cannot recur. Deploy the producer before the consumer, which the artifact dependency already enforces.
